meta.caveat: Windows have a start and an end; detection is measured from the start, clearing from the end.

amoc_definitions.sim_hours: steps * step_seconds / 3600 from each run's truth.json (not the span)
amoc_definitions.fa_per_hour_reference: flags over all reference publishes and zones (flagged: rank <= K, or cost >= c) / (n_zones_reference * sim_hours_reference); every flag on the reference is false
amoc_definitions.fa_per_hour_measured_outside_windows: sum over measured publishes of analyse_windows_k's false flags (flagged cells with no truth_positive of any kind) / (n_zones_measured * sim_hours_measured)
amoc_definitions.median_delay_s: summary.first_detect_s median over detected windows; p25 / p75 likewise
amoc_definitions.k_at_miss_below_half: first K entry (K ascending) with miss_share < 0.5, else null
amoc_definitions.cost_at_miss_below_half: first cost entry (cost descending) with miss_share < 0.5, else null
